name: spice-lite
description: A small, import-free C library that answers spacecraft geometry questions onboard from a compact ephemeris blob; built for WebAssembly sequencers.

scripts.slice: node tools/slicer.mjs test/blobs/cassini-soi.json test/blobs/cassini-soi.slb test/blobs/cassini-soi.report.json && node tools/slicer.mjs test/blobs/sun-earth-moon.json test/blobs/sun-earth-moon.slb test/blobs/sun-earth-moon.report.json
scripts.verify: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:native && pnpm test
